pillars.title: Homewood Health Centre: A World-Class Facility
pillars.body: The Homewood Health Centre is one of the largest and leading facilities for the medical treatment of mental health and addiction disorders in Canada. The center offers a multidisciplinary approach to treatment and services, ensuring their patients receive the highest level of care throughout their entire journey. From specialized programs to individualized treatment plans, the Homewood Health Centre provides unparalleled care to their patients.

pillars.title: The Unique Continuum of Care at Homewood Health
pillars.body: Homewood Health offers the most comprehensive, integrated continuum of services available in Canada. Their unique continuum of care sets them apart from others, offering a range of services that meet the specific needs of individuals and families. Homewood’s services include assessments, outpatient and inpatient treatment, recovery management, return to work and family support services. This continuum of care is designed to simplify the process, from diagnosis to treatment and beyond, making it easier for those struggling with mental health or addiction to find the right solutions.

pillars.title: Clinical Expertise at Homewood Health
pillars.body: Homewood Health prides itself on its medical and clinical expertise, developed over decades of clinical practice and patient service. Their award-winning team of clinicians, with a deep understanding of mental health and addiction, showcases their skills and experience. Clinical expertise is the foundation of everything at Homewood Health. They are constantly pushing themselves to integrate research and evidence to enhance their practice, resulting in exceptional patient outcomes.

overview: Homewood Health is a premier rehabilitation center that has been helping Canadians improve their mental health and overcome addiction for over 140 years. As part of Homewood Health’s national network of clinical experts, the facility offers personalized, evidence-based care that is tailored to the unique needs of each individual. The Homewood Health Centre, one of Canada’s largest and most respected medical centers for mental health and addiction disorders, serves as the cornerstone of the organization’s comprehensive range of services.

Each inpatient program at Homewood has a set length. The Addiction Medicine Program runs six weeks, starting with assessment, withdrawal management and stabilization before active treatment begins. The Integrated Mood, Anxiety and Addictions Concurrent Program, the Cornerstone program for traumatic stress injury, the Guardians Program for first responders, military personnel and veterans, and the Women's Trauma and Concurrent Program each run nine weeks. A twelve-week Plus version of the concurrent program moves at a slower pace for people with mild cognitive difficulties. The 16-week Eating Disorder Program, which the hospital calls the largest inpatient program of its kind in Canada, takes patients from age 16. Inpatients with treatment-resistant depression can also be referred to the Interventional Psychiatry Service for rTMS, ECT or intravenous treatment, and the hospital provides rTMS and intravenous therapy to inpatients at no extra cost.

afterOverview: Whether it is through outpatient or inpatient treatment or recovery management, Homewood Health Centre is committed to delivering exceptional outcomes that empower patients to fully engage in their personal, social and professional lives. By redefining mental health and addiction services and customizing care to meet the evolving needs of individuals and families, Homewood Health is playing a crucial role in helping Canadians achieve greater productivity, healthier relationships and a greater sense of fulfillment in their daily lives.

Homewood is a Schedule 1 facility under Ontario's Mental Health Act, and its specialized programs are elective. Ontario residents with a valid OHIP card pay a daily accommodation fee, which employer medical plans or disability insurers often cover in part or in full, and the hospital says that in many cases people with OHIP and insurance benefits pay nothing. Patients from other provinces, or without OHIP, may be funded by an employer or disability insurer, a provincial Ministry of Health, workers' compensation or another third party. Homewood also accepts Veterans Affairs Canada and RCMP health cards.

location.heading: Homewood Health Centre in Guelph, Ontario
location.intro: Homewood Health Centre is at 150 Delhi Street in Guelph, a university city in Wellington County, on more than 50 acres along the Speed River and about an hour and a quarter by car from downtown Toronto. Kitchener-Waterloo and Cambridge are roughly 25 to 30 minutes away and Hamilton about 45 minutes, and the hospital notes that most patients from outside Ontario fly into Toronto, about an hour's drive from Guelph.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: What does Homewood Health Centre cost, and does OHIP cover it?
faqs.a: In many cases, Ontario residents with a valid OHIP card and insurance benefits pay nothing out of pocket. The hospital charges Ontario residents a daily accommodation fee for its specialized programs, and employer medical plans or disability insurers often cover some or all of it. Homewood does not publish its fees, and some insurers do not cover accommodation there, so the intake team at 1-866-839-2594 recommends getting written confirmation of your coverage before admission.

faqs.q: Which programs does Homewood Health Centre offer, and how long are they?
faqs.a: Each inpatient program has a set length. The Addiction Medicine Program runs six weeks. The Integrated Mood, Anxiety and Addictions Concurrent Program, the Cornerstone trauma program, the Guardians Program and the Women's Trauma and Concurrent Program run nine weeks, the Plus concurrent program runs twelve, and the Eating Disorder Program runs 16 weeks.

faqs.q: What services does Homewood Health provide?
faqs.a: Homewood Health Centre provides assessments, inpatient treatment with withdrawal management, outpatient interventional psychiatry, recovery management and family support. Its parent company, Homewood Health, separately sells organizational wellness and employee and family assistance programs to employers, and those services are not delivered at the Guelph hospital.

faqs.q: Is Homewood Health covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Many of Homewood Health’s services are covered by insurance. It’s best to check with your insurance provider to understand what services are covered and what is not.

faqs.q: How long does treatment at Homewood Health last?
faqs.a: The length of treatment varies depending on the individual’s needs and the type of treatment required. Homewood Health takes a personalized approach and works with each patient to determine the best course of treatment.

faqs.q: Does Homewood Health Centre offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. The Addiction Medicine Program pairs 24/7 medical care with withdrawal management and stabilization in its first phase, and the concurrent programs include medically supported withdrawal management when it is needed. For opioid use, the hospital's abstinence-based approach may include opiate agonist therapy such as Suboxone or methadone.

faqs.q: Where is Homewood Health Centre, and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Homewood Health Centre is at 150 Delhi Street in Guelph, Ontario, about an hour and a quarter by car from downtown Toronto. Patients from other provinces usually fly into Toronto, which the hospital puts about an hour from Guelph. Parking is limited and not guaranteed, so Homewood asks patients to leave their car at home if they can. New patients are admitted Monday to Friday between 8 and 11 am.

faqs.q: Is Homewood Health Centre the same as The Residence at Homewood?
faqs.a: No. Homewood Health Centre is the accredited hospital at 150 Delhi Street, where Ontario residents use OHIP plus a daily accommodation fee. The Residence at Homewood is a separate private program with nine suites in its own house on the same Guelph campus, with its own intake line. Both belong to Homewood Health.

faqs.q: Is the Homewood Health Centre an accredited facility?
faqs.a: Yes, the Homewood Health Centre is accredited by Accreditation Canada, meeting the highest standards of quality and safety.

faqs.q: Does Homewood Health offer support for families during treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, Homewood Health provides family support services as part of its suite of services. Family members play an important role in a patient’s recovery, and Homewood Health recognizes the need to provide support to families during the treatment process.

faqs.q: Are there any aftercare services available after treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, Homewood Health offers recovery management services to help patients transition back into their daily lives following treatment. These services include ongoing support and resources to ensure the patient’s long-term success.

faqs.q: How does Homewood Health customize its services to meet the needs of each patient?
faqs.a: Homewood Health takes a personalized approach, beginning with an assessment to understand an individual’s needs and preferences. They use their multidisciplinary team of clinicians to create a customized treatment plan for each patient.

faqs.q: Does Homewood Health offer virtual services?
faqs.a: Yes, Homewood Health offers virtual services, including teletherapy, for certain treatment programs. These services allow patients to receive treatment from the comfort of their own home, providing a convenient option for those who cannot attend in-person sessions.

faqs.q: What is the success rate of Homewood Health's treatment programs?
faqs.a: Homewood Health’s treatment programs have a high success rate, with many patients experiencing significant improvements in their mental health and achieving long-term recovery.
